bib.title: Semantic Image Synthesis with Spatially-Adaptive Normalization

question: Can a generator synthesize photorealistic images from semantic segmentation masks better if the mask modulates the normalization layers instead of being fed in as the input?
hypothesis: Normalization layers wash away semantic information from the input mask; injecting the mask through learned spatially-varying scale and bias preserves it.
contributions: A lighter decoder-style generator without an encoder, built from SPADE ResBlks
State-of-the-art results on COCO-Stuff, ADE20K, ADE20K-outdoor, Cityscapes
Multi-modal and style-guided synthesis via an image encoder (VAE)

method.summary: A GAN generator made of SPADE residual blocks with nearest-neighbour upsampling; each normalization layer is parameter-free BatchNorm followed by per-pixel gamma and beta predicted from the resized segmentation mask by a two-layer conv net. Trained with the pix2pixHD multi-scale discriminator and loss but hinge GAN loss; optional VAE image encoder for style.
method.task: semantic image synthesis (segmentation mask to photo)

datasets.name: ADE20K-outdoor
datasets.source: outdoor subset of ADE20K, as in Qi et al. (SIMS)

datasets.name: Flickr Landscapes
datasets.preprocessing: masks computed with a DeepLabV2 model; 256x256

models.name: SPADE generator (decoder w/ SPADE)
models.architecture: Linear(256,16384), reshape to 1024x4x4, 7 SPADE ResBlk with Upsample(2) (1024,1024,1024,512,256,128,64), 3x3Conv-3 Tanh; SPADE = sync BatchNorm then 3x3-Conv-128 ReLU then two 3x3-Conv-k for gamma, beta

other.spectral_norm: all conv layers in G and D

models.name: Image encoder
models.architecture: 6 stride-2 3x3 convs (64,128,256,512,512,512) with IN, LReLU, then two linear layers (256) giving mean and variance

models.name: Discriminator
models.architecture: pix2pixHD multi-scale PatchGAN with InstanceNorm, input is concat of mask and image, spectral norm added

models.name: SIMS
models.architecture: semi-parametric, composites real segments; author-provided results used where available

models.name: pix2pixHD++
models.architecture: pix2pixHD plus sync BatchNorm, spectral norm, TTUR, hinge loss, large batch, Glorot init

models.name: DeepLabV2 / UperNet101 / DRN-D-105
models.architecture: segmentation networks used to score synthesized images (COCO-Stuff / ADE20K / Cityscapes)

training.objective: pix2pixHD objective (multi-scale GAN, feature matching, perceptual) with hinge GAN loss in place of LSGAN; same loss weights as pix2pixHD; plus KL loss (weight 0.05) when the image encoder is used
training.lr_schedule: linear decay to 0 from epoch 100 to 200 (Cityscapes, ADE20K)
training.regularisation: spectral norm on all layers in G and D; synchronized BatchNorm

inference.samples: one output per mask; multi-modal figures sample different z from a standard Gaussian

other.style_guidance: replace noise input with the image encoder's embedding of a style image

metrics.name: mIoU
metrics.definition: mean intersection-over-union of a pretrained segmentation network's prediction on the synthesized image against the input mask

metrics.name: accu
metrics.definition: pixel accuracy of the same prediction

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: Frechet Inception Distance between synthesized and real image distributions

metrics.name: User preference
metrics.definition: percentage of AMT votes favouring ours over a competitor

eval.protocol: Competing methods trained on the same training set, scored on the same validation set. AMT: 500 random questions per dataset, 5 workers each, unlimited time, workers with >98% approval. No seeds or repeated runs stated.

availability.data: public datasets; Flickr Landscapes collected by authors, release not stated

limits: Evaluation relies on pretrained segmentation networks, which only check layout agreement, plus FID and a human study with no repeated runs or seeds.
Text and Table 1 disagree on COCO-Stuff mIoU (35.2 vs 37.4).
SIMS results taken from authors where available, not retrained on large datasets.
Flickr Landscapes masks are machine-predicted, not human annotated.
Quantitative comparison is GAN-era; no diffusion models.

terms.definition: SPatially-Adaptive (DE)normalization: a conditional normalization layer whose scale and bias are tensors with spatial dimensions computed from the input segmentation mask

lineage.work: High-resolution image synthesis and semantic manipulation with conditional GANs (pix2pixHD)
lineage.note: Same discriminator and loss except hinge replaces LSGAN; main baseline

lineage.work: Image-to-image translation with conditional adversarial networks (pix2pix)
Photographic image synthesis with cascaded refinement networks (CRN)
Conditional BatchNorm (Dumoulin et al.) and AdaIN (Huang and Belongie)
lineage.note: SPADE generalizes both to spatially varying modulation

lineage.work: Recovering realistic texture in image super-resolution by deep spatial feature transform
Spectral normalization; TTUR (Heusel et al.); Auto-encoding variational Bayes
